text:
Predicates:
Generation(x) ::: x is a language generation task.
Understanding(x) ::: x is a language understanding task.
Output(x, y) ::: x is the output of y.
Task(x) ::: x is a natural language processing task.
Translation(x) ::: x is machine translation.
Sequence(x) ::: x is a text sequence.
Premises:
∀x (Task(x) → (Generation(x) ∨ Understanding(x))) ::: Natural language processing tasks can be categorized as either language generation task or language understanding task.
∀x (Output(x, y) → Generation(y)) ::: If the output of a natural language processing task is a text sequence, then it is a language generation task.
Translation(translation) ::: Machine translation is a natural language processing task.
Output(translation, sequence) ::: The output of machine translation is a text sequence.
Conclusion:
¬Understanding(translation) ::: Machine translation is a language generation task.
